faqs.question: Can Versaly systems integrate with our existing legacy databases and ERPs?
faqs.answer: Yes. All Versaly platforms are API-first and cloud-native, providing robust REST/GraphQL connectors and webhook triggers to sync with existing on-premises or cloud legacy systems.

faqs.question: What is the typical onboarding timeline for new deployments?
faqs.answer: Because our platforms are purpose-built for specific industries with intuitive zero-bloat UX, standard deployments typically take 2 to 4 weeks including data migration and staff walkthroughs.

faqs.question: How is our sensitive industry data secured and isolated?
faqs.answer: We enforce AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, tenant isolation, automated backups, and strict RBAC access controls compliant with SOC2, GDPR, and HIPAA best practices.

faqs.question: Do you offer tailored customization for enterprise workflows?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our solutions are modular, allowing our engineering team to develop dedicated workflow extensions and custom integrations tailored to your specific operational needs.
